denominators.note: odds_reconcile_state starts 2026-10-08 (b5e8f8a5); "since 2026-07-20" returns no rows before that. Absence of a lambdas row on a day is not evidence of zero calls: stranded calls are never tallied.
denominators.days_used_0_with_attempts_range: the 14 days with used 0 had 13 to 390 attempts; the 26 days span 13 to 932

query: SELECT r.day, SUM(r.n) attempts, SUM(CASE WHEN r.state='reconciled' THEN r.n ELSE 0 END) reconciled, SUM(CASE WHEN r.state='cache-hit' THEN r.n ELSE 0 END) cache_hit, SUM(CASE WHEN r.state='error' THEN r.n ELSE 0 END) err, SUM(r.credits_kept) kept, (SELECT used FROM odds_budget_site s WHERE s.day=r.day AND s.site='getWCPregameLambdas') used, (SELECT SUM(n) FROM odds_reconcile_state o WHERE o.day=r.day AND o.site<>'getWCPregameLambdas') other_sites_n FROM odds_reconcile_state r WHERE r.site='getWCPregameLambdas' GROUP BY r.day ORDER BY r.day

columns.attempts: tallied calls (stranded calls are not tallied, so a lower bound)
columns.used: odds_budget_site.used: the NET counter after refunds, in credits (4 per attempt), NOT a call count
columns.kept: credits the vendor kept; for state=error the estimate recorded as intent, not vendor billing

readers.command: grep -an 'getWCPregameLambdas\|_wcLambdaCache\|wcLambdas' src/*.js ; git grep -an 'getWCPregameLambdas\|wcLambdas\|_wcLambdaCache' origin/main -- . ':!docs' ':!outbox' ':!HANDOFF.md'  (in jubilant-bassoon and field-laboratory, each fetched first)
readers.relay: one definition (src/index.js getWCPregameLambdas), ONE call (handleV2Games, the _wcWpPossible line), four reads of the returned Map (the truthiness test, .has, .get, and one for-of), all inside the live loop of handleV2Games; none in game-do.js, ambient-do.js or wp-resolver.js. The Map is module-local: no other module can read it.

jubilant_bassoon.note: zero hits outside docs, outbox and HANDOFF (the command excludes them); the only matches in the repo are 14 lines of one report, outbox/cc-odds-audit-results.md

readers.meaning: the client can only see winProb (source label odds-blended vs shots-proxy), never the lambdas. A null Map, an empty Map and a Map matching no live game all give pregameLh/pregameLa null.

Evidence it is empty: credits_kept 0 on 1801 of 1801 reconciled calls, and the sister route /wc/odds-probs (same URL, same h2h skip) returned probs: [] in 186 of 206 committed provenance-runtime-probe artifacts (201 of them carry the route; none non-empty).

by_state.query: SELECT state, SUM(n) n, SUM(credits_kept) kept FROM odds_reconcile_state WHERE site='getWCPregameLambdas' GROUP BY state
by_state.reading: 1801 of 1801 reconciled calls kept 0 credits. The 60 kept credits are 14 error calls (6 rows, 56 credits) and 1 no-header call (4): the estimate recorded as intent, not vendor billing. cache-hit rows kept 0 because the provider was never contacted (creditsKeptBy), so only the reconciled 0s say anything about vendor billing.
